text: 1.1 Hi, come in. Sit down, take a seat. Thank you. So, erm... What's your name? Olga. Right. OK. And where are you from, Olga? Russia. Oh, OK. Whereabouts? Saratov. It's maybe 500 kilometers from Moscow. Do you know it? No, sorry, I'm afraid I don't. My geography of that area is not great. So, how long have you been learning English, Olga? About ten or twelve years on and off. Okay. So, have you been to the UK to study before? No, no. In fact, this is my first time in an English-speaking country. Really? That's amazing, because your English is really good. I mean, you haven't got a very strong accent. Thanks. I had really good teachers at school. Yeah, mine weren't that good. But then I wasn't a very good student either. Yes, I was lucky. So, how long are you going to stay here? I'm not sure. I'd like to do a degree here. Maybe in business management. But I'll see. It depends on my husband as well. He's looking for work here. Oh, okay. So how old are you, if you don't mind me asking? I'd rather not say. Oh, right. Okay. Fair enough. Anyway, I think that's all I need to ask. Hmm. I'm going to put you in the top class. Is that okay? Fine. Thanks.
